YASTM.ST_HelpDef.title: Arsenal: Energy Weapons
YASTM.ST_HelpDef.text:
Directed energy weapons are the standard armament of the 24th century, ranging from Starfleet Phasers to Klingon Disruptors and Dominion Polaron beams.

Gameplay: 
- Phasers: Feature integrated fire modes. 'Stun' safely neutralizes targets without bleeding (perfect for taking prisoners). 'Lethal' causes heavy burns. 'Overload' fires a devastating, armor-penetrating blast but consumes more weapon charge/durability.
- Disruptors: Favored by Klingons and Romulans, these weapons lack a stun setting but deal massive raw thermal damage.
- Polaron Weapons: Used by the Jem'Hadar, these unique beams are designed to bypass most conventional armor and shields.

YASTM.ST_HelpDef.title: Arsenal: Melee & Projectiles (TR-116)
YASTM.ST_HelpDef.text:
Despite advanced technology, close-quarters combat and kinetic weaponry still have their place in the galaxy.

Gameplay: 
- Melee: Canonical weapons like the Klingon Bat'leth or D'k Tahg, and the Vulcan Lirpa, provide massive melee hit bonuses and armor penetration. They are exceptionally deadly in the hands of a Klingon pawn.
- TR-116 Rifle: A rare Starfleet prototype that fires solid projectiles (tritanium bullets) instead of energy. It is highly effective in radioactive environments or against enemies equipped with energy-dampening fields where standard Phasers would fail.

YASTM.ST_HelpDef.title: Field Gadgets: Tricorders & Hyposprays
YASTM.ST_HelpDef.text:
Starfleet officers rely on specialized tools to analyze their environment and treat injuries on the fly.

Gameplay: 
- Tricorders: Equipped as utility items. 'Medical Tricorders' drastically boost tend speed and surgery success. 'Science Tricorders' increase research and scanning speeds. 'Security Tricorders' enhance combat awareness and trap detection.
- Hyposprays: An essential tool for field medics. It allows instant, needle-less administration of medicine, painkillers, or combat stims to pawns directly on the battlefield without needing a hospital bed.
- Combadges: Wearable devices that provide minor social bonuses and enable remote coordination.

YASTM.ST_HelpDef.title: Apparel: EV-Suits & Shields
YASTM.ST_HelpDef.text:
Advanced tailoring provides protection against hostile environments and enemy fire.

Gameplay: 
- Uniforms: Faction-correct tunics (TOS, TNG, etc.) visually distinguish your crew's roles (Command, Medical, Ops) and provide minor work-specific buffs.
- EV-Suits: Extravehicular suits offer absolute protection against the vacuum of space, extreme temperatures, and toxic fallout. Essential for repairing exterior hull breaches.
- Personal Shield Emitters: A wearable belt that projects a personal force field, absorbing incoming ranged attacks until its capacitor is depleted.
- Tal Shiar Suits: Specialized Romulan infiltration gear that reduces a pawn's visibility and psychic signature.

YASTM.ST_HelpDef.title: Strategic Resources
YASTM.ST_HelpDef.text:
The galactic economy and war machines run on very specific materials.

Gameplay: 
- Dilithium: Mined as raw crystal and refined at specialized benches. It is the absolute prerequisite for building and fueling Warp Cores.
- Gold-Pressed Latinum: A rare liquid encased in gold. It cannot be replicated and serves as the ultimate currency, especially when dealing with the Ferengi.
- Ketracel-White: An isogenic enzyme vital for the Jem'Hadar. You must synthesize it constantly to prevent your Dominion soldiers from going into lethal withdrawal.
- Replicator Feedstock: The digital 'ammunition' for Replicators, produced by Matter Converters from raw base materials.
